name: pane-body-composer-gap-phone
description: On a phone the session composer floats over the transcript: the body runs to the pane's bottom edge so content scrolls under the chrome and leaves no in-flow band, while a footer-less pane keeps the phone's own inset and a flush body stays edge to edge.

mutation.declaration: panescaffold.module.css: (a) the phone block's `.footer` floating rule `position: absolute` set to `static`, (b) the `.body:not(:last-child)` / `.body:last-child` pair removed, or (c) the phone block's `--pane-body-edge-inset` restatement removed
mutation.note: Each mutation was applied separately on 2026-11-24 at 390px and reverted. Making the footer static failed with 'the session body stops 36.0px above the pane's bottom edge'. Removing the selector pair failed the session fixture with a 16.0px end band (body padding-bottom 16px). Removing the phone token restatement failed the footer-less fixture with 24.0px where the breakpoint's token declares 16px - the two-sided check is what catches a leaked desktop value. The case passed again after each revert.
